note: Research largely inconclusive due to tooling failures, not due to clean findings. (1) Sanctions: could NOT be verified. The OFAC Sanctions List Search (sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov) is a JavaScript application that returned only its landing page over plain HTTP, so no SDN/Consolidated-list query could be executed; UN, EU, UK OFSI and BIS Entity List screens were likewise not reachable. sanctions_hit is therefore null = NOT CHECKED, not 'no hit'. (2) Court cases: Indian Kanoon was queried directly. Search for 'Unisearch India Instruments' returned 0 matching results; search for the broader string 'Unisearch India' returned exactly 1 judgment - 'Unisearch Charitable Trust, Chennai vs CIT(A), Chennai' (ITAT Chennai, ITA No.41/Chny/2024, 16 April 2024) - which concerns a Chennai charitable trust and is NOT the company in this batch, so it must not be attributed to it. No litigation involving the named private limited company was located, but Indian Kanoon does not index all forums (NCLT, DRT, consumer commissions, district courts), so this is a partial negative only. (3) Credit rating: no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Acuite action found; rating = null, not public in any source reached. (4) Negative news / regulator actions: no coverage found; however the search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down for the entire session ('Connection refused') and Bing returned only irrelevant results (US funeral homes, Premier League fixtures), so absence of news is a tooling artifact and should not be read as a clean record. (5) Russia/CIS supply evidence: none found, but equally not verifiable given the above. Company registry pages (Zauba Corp, TheCompanyCheck) returned HTTP 403 and Google returned HTTP 429, so no corporate filings, directors or charge data were obtained. RECOMMENDATION: this company should be re-run in a later batch with working search and a scripted OFAC/consolidated-list lookup before any risk conclusion is drawn. Per project rules, nothing here constitutes a rejection ground - no evidence of non-existence, liquidation or bankruptcy was found, and no sanctions, court or criminal matter was confirmed.
